crossRefs.note: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’
then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore…
Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin…
I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

translations.web: It shall be, if he tells you, “I will not go out from you,” because he loves you and your house, because he is well with you,
translations.bsb: But if your servant says to you, ‘I do not want to leave you,’ because he loves you and your household and is well off with you,
translations.kjv: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well
translations.asv: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go out from thee; because he loveth thee and thy house, because he is well with thee;
